limitations: Exact-SKU native assembly is not published; official structure link still points to older Stamp-S3 STEP. Shared manufacturer S3A cover STL is retained and separately photo/drawing-checked; old S3 PCB/antenna are excluded.

Black PCB mechanical outline and1mm thickness are drawing/photo estimates; exact PIN1271200px outside photograph is masked around independent headers/M2. Inward layout remains UNKNOWN, readable through public separation.
USB/contact and M2 screw/standoff retain unscaled donor mechanical CAD. Exact supplier, hidden fit, thread and solder details remain unverified.

Officially linked footprint and photos establish17+11 at1.27mm and downward headers. KiCad molded bodies are unscaled; their native metal tails disagree with the exact9.7mm drawing envelope and are omitted. Visible4mm tails use separate drawing/photo-derived geometry; tips and hidden contacts unknown.
Official product table4.7mm is module-only; exact drawing9.7mm includes installed pins. Both scopes retained; no geometry rescaling to make them agree.
The supplied pin sticker is loose in exact product packaging, not installed in the default model. The S3A antenna visible face and RGB placement are photo estimates.
No physical measurement, complete electronic PCB layout or full firmware compatibility is established.
assemblyNotes: Independently audited S3A PIN127 drawing/photos. Native shared S3A cover + explicit USB/M2 donors; orange shell and black PCB. Unscaled KiCad header bodies with drawing-derived visible tails to honor9.7mm total depth, not a borrowed complete S3 assembly.

Exact PIN127 official1200px backside photo, PCB-only mask excludes the independent header plastic/pins, M2 metal and orange cover clips. Known outside appearance only.
Exact S3A visible U-shaped antenna face traced from photo using18mm body; ±0.3mm planar/±0.5mm height estimate. Hidden conductive antenna and RF response unknown; old S3 antenna not reused.
Photo-estimated position under right lower slit, using documented18mm width; 1mm height not CAD-measured. No new light pipe/window.
Dark hexagonal visual mark over donor M2 head. Socket machining and hidden thread not certified; original donor screw solid remains unchanged.
